Ricardo, do you have children?
Yes. One daughter. She is ten years old.
Ten! My son is fifteen. Where does she study?
She studies at a bilingual school. She speaks English there.
So her English is better than yours!
Today, yes. In one year, no.
Good answer. And your wife? Does she work?
Yes, my wife works in São Paulo too.
And on the weekend?
On the weekend we are together. We travel or we go to a park.

Good afternoon. This is the school office. Tomorrow is a special day: the children have an English day at school. Classes start at eight and finish at three. Please send a small snack and one bottle of water. The parents' meeting is on Friday, at six in the evening. Thank you, and have a good afternoon.

Hi Ricardo, Paul here. You asked about my family. My wife is a teacher and she works at a school here in Miami. My son is fifteen years old and he plays baseball on Saturday. On Sunday we are together at home. Miami is good for families: the beach is near and the weekend is long. See you on Monday.
My wife and my daughter are at home. My daughter is ten years old. She studies at a bilingual school. She speaks English at school every day. On the weekend we are together.
